# SheetJS, vendored

`xlsx.mjs`, `xlsx.d.mts` (its `types/index.d.ts`) and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged from SheetJS
Community Edition 0.20.3: <https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz>. Apache-2.0.

It is kept here, not installed, because the `xlsx` package on the npm registry stops at 0.18.5 and
newer versions are published only on SheetJS's own server; SheetJS recommends keeping a local copy.
Installing knobkit then needs nothing but the npm registry.

To update: download the new tarball from <https://cdn.sheetjs.com/>, replace the three files, and
change the version above.
